title: Listing Highlight: 65' Sea Ray L650 Fly 2015 | ZEN
description: Discover this 2015 Sea Ray L650 Fly—a premium flybridge yacht combining elegant design, spacious accommodations, and reliable performance for discerning mariners.
html:
Sophisticated Coastal Cruiser With Modern Amenities And Proven Sea Ray Engineering

The 2015 Sea Ray L650 Fly represents a pinnacle of modern yacht design, offering the perfect balance of luxury, functionality, and seaworthiness for those seeking an exceptional cruising platform. Located in Belize City, this flybridge motor yacht exemplifies Sea Ray's commitment to quality construction and thoughtful interior planning.

The L650 Fly model has earned recognition among serious boaters for its distinctive profile, featuring a raised pilothouse that provides commanding visibility and a dedicated upper-deck entertaining space that transforms the cruising experience. The flybridge itself is generously proportioned, offering comfortable seating, a full helm station, and unobstructed sightlines—ideal for those who enjoy hands-on navigation and outdoor entertaining while underway.

Below deck, the L650 Fly delivers surprising spaciousness with a well-appointed master suite, guest accommodations, and a galley designed for serious provisioning. The saloon flows naturally from the galley, creating an open, inviting atmosphere for dining and relaxation. Natural light floods the interior through strategically placed windows and hatches, enhancing the sense of space and connection to the surrounding seascape.

The vessel's construction quality reflects Sea Ray's decades of marine engineering expertise. Twin diesel engines provide reliable power and efficient fuel consumption, while modern navigation and safety systems ensure confidence in all conditions. The L650 Fly's hull design balances stability with fuel efficiency, making extended cruising both practical and economical.

Key specifications include a length of 65 feet, accommodating up to six guests in comfort across multiple staterooms. The yacht's beam provides excellent stability, while the moderate draft allows access to shallow-water anchorages and protected cruising grounds throughout the Caribbean and beyond. Cruising speed typically ranges from 10 to 12 knots, with a maximum speed exceeding 15 knots when conditions permit.

This 2015 model benefits from recent Sea Ray innovations in systems integration, entertainment, and comfort technology. The flybridge helm station includes modern instrumentation, while the saloon entertainment system keeps guests connected and entertained during extended voyages. The galley is equipped with full-size appliances, and the heads feature modern fixtures and ample storage. For those considering a Caribbean-based charter operation or extended family cruising, the L650 Fly offers proven reliability, excellent guest capacity, and the kind of distinctive profile that turns heads in any anchorage. The Belize City location provides immediate access to some of the world's most pristine cruising grounds, from the Belize Barrier Reef to the Bay Islands and beyond.
